narrative.daily: Portfolio is growing today (+0.46%). SMH led (+1.24%, Semiconductors / AI); KSTR lagged (-0.49%, China Tech (STAR 50)).

narrative.ytd: Year-to-date (fund-level, value-weighted) the book is up ~49.8%. Best: FLXK +78.0% (Asia-Tech (Korea)). Worst: PHPM -15.0% (Precious Metals (hedge)).

reco: Concentration: ~60% of the equity book sits in Asia-Tech + Emerging (Taiwan/Korea/China/semis). The Asia-Tech world theme is currently Favoured (score 62.5), so the tilt is broadly with the wind — but single-region concentration this high carries real drawdown risk if the theme rolls over.

Dollar is Strong (DXY above its 200-day). That is a headwind for your EM sleeves (China/Korea/Taiwan) and for precious metals — PHPM is your weakest holding YTD. A stronger-for-longer dollar argues for trimming the EM beta or hedging FX.

Developed-West is the highest-scoring world theme right now (score 69.4, Favoured) yet you hold almost none of it. Adding a Developed-West sleeve (e.g. an S&P 500 / MSCI World UCITS line) would cut single-theme risk and lean into the strongest tape.
Macro backdrop is supportive (US diffusion = Expansion, recession risk LOW), so there is no defensive trigger to de-risk wholesale — this is a rebalancing question (trim/rotate), not a get-out call.
